s: Gnorris is a small, portly gnome who makes his appearance in the PC/DOS game I.M. Meen. He is actually one of Meen's henchmen, often referring to him as 'the boss', but he betrays the powerful wizard out of fear. At the end of each major section of Meen's labyrinth, Gnorris appears to the children in order to aid them with advice or some magical item.
